purpose: Eight-game functional/trend diagnostic; no Elo or causal training-effect estimate

definitions.target_window: Actual move ply <=80 (pre-move root ply<80); reaching 80 plies counts even for capped games, with outcomes separated. This reporting window does not reinterpret the recorded policy's phase schedule
definitions.close: abs(White-perspective finite exact CP)<=100 (inclusive); CP ratios use available validated finite scores only. Validated mates are separately counted outside; missing, incoherent or inexact scores are unknown. Neither counts as inside
definitions.continuous_band: Each game's first 40 sparring moves have separate baseline, selected-root and Stockfish-next-root sequences. Sustained success requires reaching 80 plies and all 40 samples known inside. Partial all-inside prefixes are separate; no concatenation across games or evaluators, and no every-halfmove continuity claim. Pacing exceptions never convert outside samples into inside
definitions.band_ply_axis: ply and first_exit_ply identify the associated sparring move. evaluation_record_ply identifies the move record containing the search; its root board has one fewer ply. Stockfish's initial white root is excluded; its root after Black's 40th move is in record 81 (board ply 80) and is unknown if absent
definitions.recovery: Consecutive outside samples followed immediately by a known inside sample; own_turns counts sparring turns from the first outside sample. Unknown breaks both outside runs and recovery evidence
definitions.pacing: Pacing stages and resource guards are policy receipts, grouped by event_ply separately within each game; not independent proof of a human blunder. Strict selected-root classification and consecutive outside-to-inside restoration use validated scores, ignoring relaxed pacing status. Unknown breaks recovery evidence; temporary outside scores still fail strict continuity
definitions.phase_activation: Board reach at the policy's ramp/finish thresholds is separate from an actual valid matching decision. v2 roots80/138 activate White81/139 and Black82/140; v1 roots100/140 activate White101/141 and Black102/142. No early material phase guard
definitions.baseline: Own-engine unrestricted root score before policy selection; this is the gauge reference, not the played move score
definitions.selected: Own-engine candidate_compared CP for an alternative, baseline score otherwise; finite-baseline cases require the same depth. The explicit v2 winning-mate exception instead requires independently verified finite compared/final CP at depth>=4. Known outside values remain outside. Same pre-move root, not a later-board evaluation. Recomputed from score evidence, never trusted from band_control status
definitions.mate_avoidance: A validated positive own-perspective exact mate reference with a complete legal matching mate PV is declined for an independently verified finite candidate before ply80. Separate from CP-loss concessions; in-band mate avoidance has a separate count. Baseline CP, loss CP and CP subtraction remain null; raw mate scores are never converted to CP
definitions.stability: Finite exact CP includes provisional iterations; the stable-only baseline subset is separately reported
definitions.stockfish: Auxiliary next-root score after the sparring move and before Stockfish moves; not its weakened selected-move score. play merged-info depth/score packet coherence is not established
definitions.latency: Observed host wall time, not CPU time; measured overhead is not automatically a time-control failure
definitions.move_denominator: All legally replayed recorded prefixes, including capped/failed games; game outcomes and incomplete categories are separate
definitions.trends: Profile and control targets reflect the algorithm's receipts; not independently calibrated human skill. No transitions are joined across games
definitions.limitations: Two games per setting, adaptive strength, asymmetric extra budgets and no full-power control group; no Elo, objective CP calibration, human-feel, or guaranteed-win conclusion
